about.title: About us
about.standfirst: Oceania Business Council (OBCI) is a Melbourne-based, not-for-profit membership organisation.
about.introTitle: Based in Melbourne, connecting China, Australia and Oceania
about.introBody1: The Oceania Business Council (OBCI) is a non-profit international business organisation headquartered in Melbourne, Australia. We bring together significant resources from Australia and the international community: political leaders including former federal ministers, former Speakers and former Lord Mayors; leading entrepreneurs across industries; industry associations and chambers of commerce; financial and investment institutions; professional advisory teams; and universities and research institutes.
about.introBody2: We have always believed that truly successful international cooperation is more than a commercial transaction — it is shared growth built on trust, resource sharing and long-term collaboration. OBCI is therefore not just a business council in the traditional sense, but an international business platform that brings together government and business resources, industry ecosystems, international cooperation and on-the-ground delivery, giving businesses all-round support as they grow globally.
about.introBody3: The Oceania Business Council Inc. is a membership-based, non-profit organisation comprising Australian businesses and business organisations from other countries in Oceania. Founded in Melbourne, it provides services to members in Australia and across Oceania, organises business-focused activities regularly, and is establishing representative offices in many Oceania cities, supported by local governments and chambers of commerce and industry, to serve members in Australia.
about.pillarsStandfirst: How the vision is delivered — the association's four core lines of work.
about.structureText: The council comprises the Executive Committee, Honorary Patrons, Councillors, the Secretariat and the professional committees.
